facts.heading: Marriage duration
facts.content: Jana and Radko were married for fifteen years.
facts.evidence: After fifteen years of marriage, my husband Radko and I decided on a divorce.

facts.heading: Divorce decision timing
facts.content: Radko told Jana the divorce couldn't continue in September.
facts.evidence: And in September he told me that it couldn't go on like this.

facts.heading: Jana's emotional state
facts.content: Jana experiences alternating feelings of emptiness and anger.
facts.evidence: Emptiness. And then anger. Then emptiness again.

facts.heading: Radko's reason for divorce
facts.content: Radko stated that the couple drifted apart and lived next to each other.
facts.evidence: He says that we drifted apart. That we live next to each other.

facts.heading: Jana's self-blame
facts.content: Jana feels she should have noticed the drifting apart.
facts.evidence: That I should have seen it. That I am blind.

facts.heading: Jana's uncertainty about fault
facts.content: Jana wonders if she was too tired or cared too much.
facts.evidence: Sometimes I think I was too tired and didn't care about him, other times that I cared too much.

facts.heading: Children's ages
facts.content: Jana has two children, Anička who is twelve and Matěj who is eight.
facts.evidence: Anička is twelve and Matěj is eight years old.

facts.heading: Delay in telling children
facts.content: Jana and Radko have been putting off telling the children about the divorce.
facts.evidence: Radek wants us to tell them together, but we keep putting it off.

facts.heading: Anička's suspicion
facts.content: Anička has already suspected something about the situation.
facts.evidence: Anička already suspects something.

facts.heading: Jana lied to Anička
facts.content: Jana lied to Anička when she asked if Dad and Jana were fighting.
facts.evidence: Last week she asked me if Dad and I are fighting. I said no.

facts.heading: Jana's feeling after lying
facts.content: Jana felt terrible after lying to Anička.
facts.evidence: I felt terrible.

facts.heading: Housing arrangements
facts.content: The apartment is on a mortgage, and Radko is likely moving in with his brother.
facts.evidence: The apartment is on a mortgage. Radek is probably moving in with his brother, at least for now.

facts.heading: Children's living situation
facts.content: The children will stay with Jana.
facts.evidence: The children will stay with me.

facts.heading: Jana's fear about managing alone
facts.content: Jana is afraid she won't manage the situation alone because Radko handled money.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I won't manage it alone. Radek always dealt with money.

facts.heading: Jana's profession and students
facts.content: Jana works as a Czech teacher at an elementary school in Brno. She teaches nine-year-olds and eight-year-olds.
facts.evidence: I work as a Czech teacher at an elementary school in Brno. I teach nine-year-olds and eight-year-olds.

facts.heading: Feeling life is falling apart
facts.content: Jana feels everyone sees that her life is falling apart.
facts.evidence: I have the feeling that everyone sees that my life is falling apart.

facts.heading: Principal knows about distress
facts.content: Only the principal at Jana's school knows about her distress.
facts.evidence: Only the principal. I told her

facts.heading: Principal allowed early departure
facts.content: The principal allowed Jana to leave early, giving her an hour off.
facts.evidence: That she let me leave early. She gave me an hour off.

facts.heading: Worsening when alone at home
facts.content: Jana felt worse when she was alone at home compared to being at work.
facts.evidence: But then I sat at home and it was worse.

facts.heading: Sleep pattern and worry
facts.content: Jana wakes up at three in the morning every night thinking about the future.
facts.evidence: Every night I wake up at three in the morning and think about what will happen next.

facts.heading: Worries about finances and children
facts.content: Jana worries about not having a mortgage or a husband, and calculating money to tell her children.
facts.evidence: I don't have a mortgage, I don't have a husband, I don't have anything. Then I calculate the money, then I imagine how I will tell the children.

facts.heading: Sleep duration and fatigue
facts.content: Jana falls asleep around five and wakes up at half past seven, feeling tired in the morning.
facts.evidence: I fall asleep around five, and I wake up at half past seven. I am tired already in the morning.

facts.heading: Weight loss and friend's comment
facts.content: Jana has lost four kilos and a friend told her she looks terrible.
facts.evidence: I lost four kilos. A friend says I look terrible.

facts.heading: Support system includes sister and friend
facts.content: Jana has her sister Alena in Olomouc, who calls her almost every evening, and a friend Eva from work.
facts.evidence: I have my sister Alena in Olomouc. She calls me almost every evening. And a friend Eva from work.

facts.heading: Jana shares details with sister
facts.content: Jana tells Alena almost everything about her life.
facts.evidence: Alena almost everything.

facts.heading: Jana limits sharing with Eva
facts.content: Jana only tells Eva that she is having a difficult period.
facts.evidence: Eva only that I am having a difficult period.

facts.heading: Fear of perceived failure
facts.content: Jana fears that she has failed and that a woman who cannot maintain a marriage is not a good example for children.
facts.evidence: That I have failed. That a woman who cannot maintain a marriage is not a good example for children.

facts.heading: Mother's influence on beliefs
facts.content: Jana believes her mother's words influenced her fears, as her mother always said marriage lasts no matter what.
facts.evidence: Probably from my mom. She always said that marriage lasts no matter what.

facts.heading: Mother's recent silence and comment
facts.content: Jana's mother has not spoken much since saying she hoped Jana had thought things through properly.
facts.evidence: She hasn't spoken much since then.

facts.heading: Jana's current feeling of sadness
facts.content: Jana feels sad and wishes for her mother to hug her.
facts.evidence: Sad. I would like her to hug me.

facts.heading: Difficulty expressing needs in family
facts.content: Jana feels she cannot express her need to not be alone in her family.
facts.evidence: That I don't want to be alone. But that's not done in our family.

facts.heading: Crying when expressing feelings
facts.content: When Jana says her feelings out loud, she cries and apologizes.
facts.evidence: I cry. I apologize.

facts.heading: Finding relief in speaking out
facts.content: Jana finds that saying everything out loud helps her a little.
facts.evidence: it helps a little.

facts.heading: Immediate needs for relief
facts.content: Jana needs sleep and guidance on how to tell her children about her situation.
facts.evidence: Sleep. And knowing how to tell the children.

facts.heading: Uses chamomile tea for sleep
facts.content: Jana has tried chamomile tea for sleep.
facts.evidence: Chamomile tea, and that's it

facts.heading: Refuses doctor's sleep pills
facts.content: Jana does not want to take the pills the doctor offered.
facts.evidence: I don't want them

facts.heading: Fear of missing children's wake-up
facts.content: Jana is afraid she won't be able to wake up in time for the children.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I won't be able to wake up in time for the children

facts.heading: Desire not to be dependent
facts.content: Jana does not want to be dependent on medication.
facts.evidence: And I don't want to be dependent

facts.heading: Agrees to tracking wake-up
facts.content: Jana is willing to write down what wakes her up next to the bed.
facts.evidence: I could

facts.heading: Fear of panicking for children
facts.content: Jana is afraid she will panic and cry around the children.
facts.evidence: That I'll panic and cry

facts.heading: Fear of crying in front of children
facts.content: Jana is afraid of crying in front of the children.
facts.evidence: That I would cry in front of the children

facts.heading: Anička is sensitive
facts.content: Jana believes Anička is sensitive.
facts.evidence: Anička is sensitive

facts.heading: Feels not alone, not needing immediate fix
facts.content: Jana feels she is not alone and does not have to manage the situation right away.
facts.evidence: That I am not alone and that I don't have to manage it right away
